Ah, the empty output from that first test script was just my own filter bug, not a real issue. That resolves it.

I renamed `get_user_name` to `fetch_user_name` everywhere in `userlib`: 17 changes across 9 files.

- **Definition:** `userlib/core.py`.
- **Imports and calls:** `userlib/feature_0.py` through `userlib/feature_7.py`. Each file had one import and one call.
- **`get_user_name_legacy`:** unchanged. I made the edit with a search-and-replace that matches the whole name only, so the longer name wasn't touched. A search afterwards confirmed no old `get_user_name` references are left.
- **Behavior:** I imported all eight feature modules and ran `label()` on a sample user. Each one still returns `Ada Lovelace / Lovelace, Ada`.

The project has no test suite, so this quick run was the only check. `userlib/__init__.py` is empty and needed no change. Code outside this repo that still imports `get_user_name` will break, because I didn't add an alias for the old name.
